name: com.timbojimbo.ui.layout
description: A layout engine for UGUI, modelled on Clay: fit, grow, fixed and percent sizing, padding, gap, alignment, floating elements and aspect ratios, computed as a pure pass and committed to RectTransforms once.

samples.description: A showcase scene: the sizing modes, alignment, shrink and wrap, floating, aspect ratio and a scrolling list, with buttons that add rows, flip a direction, change a gap and pulse an Offset.
